Put simply? That means reinventing everyday essentials.

"By applying to this pool position, you can explore multiple internship opportunities within the business area. What we are looking for

Unlock your potential. Make it count.

Together, Forward for good.

jobs.occupation: Senior Staff Engineer Process Integration for Wide Bandgap Power Technologies (w/m/div)
jobs.description:
Part of your life. Part of tomorrow.

We make life easier, safer and greener, with technology that achieves more, consumes less and is accessible to everyone. Microelectronics from Infineon is the key to a better future. Efficient use of energy, environmentally-friendly mobility and security in a connected world we solve some of the most critical challenges that our society faces while taking a conscientious approach to the use of natural resources. 1 Senior Staff Engineer Process Integration for Wide Bandgap Power Technologies (w/m/div) Technologies in our Manufacturing and Operations team, your contribution ensures that innovation never stands still. Together, we make reliability our strongest asset. Are you in?

Your Role

Key responsibilities in your new role

 * Apply advanced statistical methods and AI applications to support technology stabilization, yield improvement, and cost optimization across the global process chain

 * Act as the Front-End representative for the development of WBG power technologies, collaborating closely with development and transfer teams

 * Drive and manage actions resulting from technology ramp-up activities following the official production release

 * Take full ownership of yield planning and ensure continuous yield monitoring to meet performance targets

 * Lead and participate in root cause analysis teams to define sustainable corrective and preventive actions for process deviations

 * Sustain and optimize high-volume production by contributing expert know-how on process and equipment capabilities in collaboration with global partner fabs

 * Execute release and delivery decisions for production goods in strict alignment with established quality and production standards

Your Profile

Qualifications and skills to help you succeed

 * A Master's or PhD degree in Electrical Engineering, Physics, Data Science, or a comparable technical field

 * Several years of professional experience in semiconductor manufacturing, focusing on technology development, process, or yield engineering

 * Technical expertise in Silicon or WBG technologies (SiC/GaN) and experience supporting technology ramp-ups in high-volume environments

 * Advanced skills in statistical data analysis (SPC, DOE) and the application of AI/Machine Learning for process optimization

 * A structured and analytical mindset with a proven ability to drive complex topics independently from analysis to implementation

 * Excellent communication and interface skills to collaborate effectively across global production, quality, and development teams

 * Fluency in English is required, with German language skills being a distinct advantage in our international environment

We offer competitive salaries and additional benefits based on your performance, experience and qualification. The employment is in accordance with the collective salary and wage agreement for employees of the electrical and electronics industry, employment group H (https://www.feei.at/aktuelles/mindestloehne-und-gehaelter-eei/). The monthly salary is paid 14 times p.a. We offer a higher compensation depending on your expertise and skills.

Apply to this position online by following the URL and entering the Job ID in our job search.

1 Senior AI Integration Architect (m/f/x) Long Description
We believe in Hiring Talents and want to see you grow and drive our product & organization to the next level. As the leading AI powered observability platform on the market, Dynatrace provides the strongest foundation for Autonomous Intelligence in the domain. By rapidly complementing Dynatrace AI with Agentic AI we turn automated IT, cloud- and AI operations into autonomous software delivery, site reliability, security and business analytics.

With our AI Adoption & Integration Specialist role, we approach you to make sure that emerging technology trends on the market are correctly reflected in our product, to proactively address our customers' needs.

In close collaboration with the Dynatrace CTO and the product leadership teams, you will have the role of driving the development of product features.

Your role at Dynatrace
Dynatrace is the leading AI-powered observability platform. By complementing Dynatrace AI with agentic AI, we aim to turn automated IT, cloud and AI operations into autonomous software delivery, reliability, security and business analytics. In close collaboration with the CTO and product leadership, you will drive the development of product features and help ensure emerging technological trends are reflected in our product and processes. There is the opportunity to move into a dedicated leadership role after the first year.

You will

 * Provide technical advice across the product lifecycle, including innovation, conceptualization, and in-development features.
 * Learn the product and use that knowledge to validate technical proposals and internal use cases.
 * Address and analyze technology and market trends and derive valuable propositions.
 * Combine deep technical work with future-facing product development.
 * Present evidence-based technical recommendations and implementation plans to senior leadership.
 * Identify improvements in user experience and operational workflows.
 * Set your own goals derived from assigned topics.

What will help you succeed
 * Extensive experience.
 * Mandatory software-architecture background.
 * Hands-on cloud-native experience (e.g., containers, orchestration, cloud services); hyperscaler familiarity is a plus.
 * Solid knowledge of AI technologies and market trends.
 * Strong systems thinking, structured communication, and the ability to apply technical knowledge to internal use cases and product topics.

Why you will love being a Dynatracer
 * A one-product software company creating real value for the largest enterprises and millions of end customers globally, striving for a world where software works perfectly.
 * Working with the latest technologies and at the forefront of innovation in tech on scale; but also, in other areas like marketing, design, or research.
 * A team that thinks outside the box, welcomes unconventional ideas, and pushes boundaries.
 * An environment that fosters innovation, enables creative collaboration, and allows you to grow.
 * A globally unique and tailor-made career development program recognizing your potential, promoting your strengths, and supporting you in achieving your career goals.
 * A truly international mindset with Dynatracers from different countries & cultures all over the world, and English as the corporate language that connects us all
 * A culture that is being shaped by the diverse personalities, expertise, and backgrounds of our global team.
